honest_admission: My earlier `headless_parse exit 0` health checks were misleading: Godot's `--headless --quit` exits 0 even when scripts fail to compile — it just prints SCRIPT ERROR lines to stderr. The new launch_check greps for 'Parse Error|Compile Error|Failed to load' so it actually catches these failures.
